## MVP5.30.5 — explicit derived-calibration provenance and inherited aperture QC

Patch `0.5.30.5` fixes the remaining aperture-stability propagation gap for derived calibrations.

Changes:

- `calibration_versions` now has explicit `source_calibration_version_id` provenance.
- New migration: `scripts/migrate_mvp5_30_5_calibration_provenance.sql`.
- Derived calibrations produced by preliminary, aperture-ZP, ensemble and PS1/color calibration now write both:
  - `calibration_versions.source_calibration_version_id`;
  - legacy JSON keys `parameters.source_calibration_name` and `parameters.source_calibration_version_id`.
- `compute-object-qc` resolves the source calibration by FK first, then by legacy JSON fallback.
- `compute-object-qc` inherits `aperture_stability`, `APERTURE_UNSTABLE` and `APERTURE_MEDIAN_SHIFT` from the source calibration when the target calibration does not have its own aperture-stability layer.
- New maintenance command:

```bash
grandgousier transfer-aperture-stability-qc \
  --target-calibration-name master_test_20230919_s1_v30_ps1_i_color_v1 \
  --source-calibration-name master_test_20230919_s1_v30_aperture_zp_i_v1 \
  --catalog-name gaia_dr3_master
```

Without `--source-calibration-name`, the command uses target calibration provenance. By default it updates only existing target `object_qc` rows. Add `--create-missing` only when a minimal inherited aperture-stability row is acceptable.

`field-qc-report` now includes inherited source aperture-stability counts in `object_qc.flag_counts`, so `APERTURE_UNSTABLE` / `APERTURE_MEDIAN_SHIFT` remain visible for PS1/color-derived calibration reports after the source calibration has already been diagnosed.

---

## MVP5.30.7 — smarter field-series resolver for field-qc-report

Patch `0.5.30.7` fixes the `field-qc-report --field-series-name` case where the persistent `field_series` row was created under an older pipeline prefix, but the user passes a newer derived calibration prefix.

The resolver now derives aliases from the target calibration and its source-calibration chain and can fall back to frame overlap between `measurements.calibration_version_id` and `field_series_frames`. This makes names like `master_test_20230919_s1_v30` resolve to the existing series whose stored `last_calibration_prefix` is `master_test_20230919_s1_v27`, when the target calibration is `master_test_20230919_s1_v30_ps1_i_color_v1`.

If no series can be resolved, the error now lists available `field_series` rows instead of returning a bare `ValueError`.

Example:

```powershell
python -m grandgousier.cli field-qc-report `
  --field-series-name master_test_20230919_s1_v30 `
  --calibration-name master_test_20230919_s1_v30_ps1_i_color_v1 `
  --catalog-name gaia_dr3_master `
  --out reports\check_05307_series_filtered_by_name.json
```

Expected result for the current test database: `frame_selection_mode=field_series`, `series_id=1`, `selected_frame_ids_count=18`, `n_frames=18`.


---

## MVP5.30.8 — pipeline idempotency audit

Patch `0.5.30.9` adds a read-only idempotency audit for repeated `run-field-pipeline` executions.

New command:

```powershell
python -m grandgousier.cli pipeline-idempotency-report `
  --field-series-name master_test_20230919_s1_v30 `
  --calibration-name master_test_20230919_s1_v30_ps1_i_color_v1 `
  --catalog-name gaia_dr3_master `
  --out reports\check_05308_idempotency.json
```

The audit checks logical duplicate identities in:

- `measurements`: `object_id, frame_id, calibration_version_id`;
- `object_qc`: `object_id, catalog_name, instrument_unit_id, calibration_version_id, algorithm`;
- `source_detections`: `frame_id, algorithm, rounded x/y position`;
- `detection_catalog_matches`: `frame_id, catalog_source_id, catalog_name, algorithm`;
- `frame_qc`: `frame_id, catalog_name, algorithm`;
- `event_detection_links`: `event_id, source_detection_id` when the event-detection layer exists.

The command returns exit code `0` for OK/WARNING and `2` when real duplicate violations are found. `MISSING` checks are used for optional tables such as `event_detection_links` when the corresponding migration has not been applied.

This patch does not change existing science tables and does not require a DB migration. It is a diagnostic guard before and after repeated pipeline runs.


## Patch 0.5.30.9

Fixes `run-field-pipeline` failure introduced by provenance support: aperture/preliminary/ensemble calibration modules now import `set_source_calibration`, and regression coverage checks that the symbol is available before pipeline runtime. No database migration is required.

---

## MVP5.31.0 — science light-curve product foundation

Patch `0.5.31.0` starts the main science-product layer: database-backed light curves with explicit series/calibration provenance, QC flags and an inter-series offset slot.

New migration:

```powershell
psql -U grandgousier -d grandgousier -h localhost -f scripts\migrate_mvp5_31_0_lightcurve_product.sql
```

The migration adds `interseries_calibration_offsets`. The table is intentionally empty until the later inter-series solver is implemented. When no offset exists, exported science light curves use the best selected calibrated magnitude as `mag_global` and set `interseries_offset_mag` to null / `NO_INTERSERIES_OFFSET`.

New commands:

```powershell
python -m grandgousier.cli list-light-curve-objects `
  --catalog-name gaia_dr3_master `
  --calibration-name master_test_20230919_s1_v31_ensemble_g_v1 `
  --field-series-name master_test_20230919_s1_v31 `
  --min-points 10 `
  --format table
```

```powershell
python -m grandgousier.cli light-curve-summary `
  --catalog-name gaia_dr3_master `
  --calibration-name master_test_20230919_s1_v31_ensemble_g_v1 `
  --field-series-name master_test_20230919_s1_v31 `
  --out reports\check_05310_light_curve_summary.json
```

```powershell
python -m grandgousier.cli export-light-curve `
  --catalog-name gaia_dr3_master `
  --source-id 2304906332682275456 `
  --calibration-name master_test_20230919_s1_v31_ensemble_g_v1 `
  --field-series-name master_test_20230919_s1_v31 `
  --out exports\light_curves\gaia_2304906332682275456_v31.csv
```

Science CSV columns include `object_id`, `catalog_name`, `source_id`, `frame_id`, `series_id`, `measurement_id`, `calibration_name`, `calibration_version_id`, `mjd`, `jd`, `date_obs`, instrument/filter fields, `mag_cal`, `mag_global`, `mag_global_err`, inter-series offset fields, JSON QC flags, `is_rejected` and `reject_reasons`.

Default science rejection flags include high RMS, faint/noisy objects, crowding/blend flags, edge flags, weak/no detection support, catalog outliers, aperture instability and saturated-like objects. The export keeps rejected rows by default and marks them explicitly; add `--exclude-rejected` to write only accepted science points.

The existing legacy commands `show-lightcurve` and `export-lightcurve` are unchanged. The new hyphenated `export-light-curve` is the science-product exporter.



## MVP 5.31.4 — safer auto-catalog execution

Patch-level safety update for `process-archive-path` auto catalogs. Automatic Gaia fetch now defaults to a single field-union cone per input path instead of per-frame queries. The command refuses to run the heavy photometry pipeline when an auto catalog fails or inserts zero sources, unless `--allow-empty-catalog` is explicitly supplied for debugging. Added best-effort astroquery timeout/radius controls and manifest fields for query mode, queried cones, read rows and oversized-cone skips. No database migration is required.

## MVP 5.31.2 — process-archive-path test hotfix

Patch-level fix for the process-archive-path regression test double: the fake SQLAlchemy query object now implements `one_or_none()`, matching the production path used when creating instrument units during explicit path indexing. No database migration is required.

### MVP5.31.5 — auto-catalog footprint fallback

`process-archive-path` auto-catalog mode can now build an approximate Gaia query
cone from indexed frame center coordinates and instrument pixel scale when the
raw FITS header lacks a complete celestial WCS. This is intended for RoboPhot
raw-frame bootstrapping.


## MVP5.31.6 — RoboPhot auto-catalog footprint fallback fix

Fixes `process-archive-path` auto-catalog bootstrapping for RoboPhot frames whose Gaia footprint cannot be evaluated through full Astropy WCS.  The Gaia cone builder now falls back to `CRVAL1/CRVAL2` plus FITS `CD*` matrix scale, and selected frames eager-load `instrument_unit` so the indexed-center fallback can use instrument pixel scale.  This prevents `failed_frames=all` / `queried_cones=0` on binned solved RoboPhot FITS headers.

## MVP5.31.9 — large-catalog batching and faster detection matching

The field pipeline now writes large PostgreSQL INSERT/UPSERT operations in safe
chunks instead of building one giant SQL statement.  This fixes the RoboPhot
auto-catalog case where 13k Gaia sources exceeded psycopg/PostgreSQL bind
parameter limits during forced photometry.  The same batching path is applied to
raw and derived measurements, frame-catalog links, source detections,
detection-catalog matches, and object QC rows.

Detection-to-catalog matching also uses a conservative pixel-grid prefilter
before the final sky-coordinate separation test, avoiding the expensive full
all-pairs loop for large Gaia catalogs.



## MVP5.32.0 — staged optimized photometry, pre-QC and working catalog

Patch `0.5.32.0` changes the one-command RoboPhot/MASTER path workflow from a
fully exhaustive diagnostic run to a staged production-safe photometry run.  The
previous default could repeatedly run full forced-aperture photometry during
aperture-stability QC and could measure every Gaia source in a deep `G<20.5`
auto catalog.  In crowded/low-latitude fields this produced several full
`~5e5` measurement passes and multi-hour executions.

Key changes:

- `process-archive-path` now runs a cheap pre-photometry frame QC stage before
  forced photometry.  It records `n_local_maxima_before_cap`,
  `DETECTION_CAP_REACHED`, bright-pixel/background-structure proxies and BAD/WARNING
  flags in `frames.quality_flags["frame_pre_photometry_qc_v1"]`.
- The source detector also records the raw candidate count before its save cap,
  so `source_detections=2000` is no longer ambiguous by itself.
- The auto Gaia identity catalog can still be deep, but the working set used for
  `frame_catalog_links` and forced photometry is separately limited.
  `process-archive-path` defaults to `--working-catalog-mag-limit 19.0`,
  `--max-working-sources-per-frame 2000`, and `--catalog-edge-margin-pix 20`.
- Existing frame-catalog links for the same catalog/frame are replaced when the
  working set is rebuilt, so old oversized links do not silently keep feeding
  photometry.
- Calibration version names include a working-set tag, for example
  `_work_g19_max2000_edge20_`, preventing accidental reuse of bloated older raw
  measurement layers.
- Raw forced photometry can reuse already complete raw measurements and can be
  explicitly recomputed with `--force-recompute-photometry`.
- `process-archive-path` disables the detection branch and aperture-stability
  sweep by default.  Use `--enable-detection-branch` and
  `--enable-aperture-stability-qc` when those diagnostics are intentionally
  needed.
- Pipeline step records now include `elapsed_sec` and are copied into the
  process manifest, making long-running stages visible.

No database migration is required.  The new pre-QC diagnostics are stored in the
existing `frames.quality_flags` JSONB column.

## MVP5.32.1 — pre-QC exclusion guard

Patch `0.5.32.1` fixes the `--exclude-bad-pre-qc-frames` control flow.

When pre-photometry QC rejects every selected frame, the pipeline now stops
before catalog matching and forced photometry.  The previous behavior converted
an empty explicit frame list to `None`, which lower-level stages interpret as
"all frames for this instrument unit".  That could make a path-scoped run resume
on unrelated frames from the same series/instrument unit.

The new behavior records a `stop_no_usable_frames` step and returns
`DONE_NO_SCIENCE_FRAMES` for the series with `science_status=BAD_FRAME_QC` in the
process manifest.  The command finishes as `DONE_WITH_WARNINGS` rather than
starting catalog matching on the wrong frame set.

No database migration is required.


## Обновление 0.5.37.2 — 2026-08-03

Реальный прогон 0.5.37.1 завершился `DONE/OK` и оценил lower-envelope floor как `0.0227607 mag`. Hypothetical effective errors дали normalized robust sigma `1.0902` и reduced chi-square `1.5038`, однако frame-common subtraction не поддержана: floor вырос до `0.0250404 mag`, а median absolute pairwise correlation — с `0.10612` до `0.11391`. BK Lyn (`object_id=6751`) корректно сохранена как `DIAGNOSTIC / NEAR_THRESHOLD_LOW_AMPLITUDE`.

0.5.37.2 добавляет формальный support gate для frame-common term. Измеренное after-common значение сохраняется, но independent floor публикуется только при одновременном улучшении floor не менее чем на 5% и median absolute correlation не менее чем на 0.01. Hypothetical uncertainty разделена на `mag_err_effective_detector_only` и `mag_err_effective_total`; compatibility alias `mag_err_effective` и candidate A/B используют total form `hypot(mag_err_random, floor)`. Science `mag_err_random`, weights и thresholds не меняются.

## Обновление 0.5.37.3 — 2026-08-03

Исправлен `show-catalog-sources`: команда больше не обращается к отсутствующим
`calibration_name` / `instrument_unit_id` и не применяет `offset/limit` дважды.
`process-archive-path` теперь до построения series/pipeline проверяет явно
переданный identity catalog. Пустой или отсутствующий namespace завершает
команду со статусом `FAILED_PRECONDITION_CATALOG`; прежнее продолжение с нулём
catalog links доступно только через диагностический `--allow-empty-catalog`.
Фотометрия, residual-floor semantics и candidate membership не меняются.


## Обновление 0.5.38.0 — 2026-08-03

На трёх RoboPhot сериях BK Lyn residual floor воспроизводится на уровне 0.02276–0.02567 mag, но single-series candidate exclusion показал каскадный рост 25→31 requested exclusions в серии 2026-04-02 `r`. 0.5.38.0 не меняет photometry, `mag_err_random` или thresholds. Вместо этого добавлены два слоя безопасности.

Команда `candidate-evidence-report` читает несколько export directories, объединяет объекты по `source_id`, сопоставляет одновременные эпохи и вычисляет Pearson/Spearman coherence. Для контрольных экспортов BK Lyn (`702296666944246784`) при explicit target override получает `TARGET_COHERENT_MULTI_FILTER`: 70 пар, Pearson около 0.283, Spearman около 0.294.

Candidate-excluded ensemble получает growth policy. Новый default `initial_only` выполняет первый candidate-excluded pass по исходному accepted set и target, но не добавляет newly appearing candidates на последующих пересчётах. Для исторического поведения доступно `--candidate-ensemble-growth-policy all`. Target provenance публикуется как `EXPLICIT_SOURCE_ID`, `EXPLICIT_OBJECT_ID`, `AUTO_NEAREST_TO_FIELD_CENTER` или `DISABLED_UNRESOLVED`. Миграция БД не требуется.

## Обновление 0.5.38.1 — 2026-08-03

Hotfix исправляет семантику `candidate-evidence-report` без изменения фотометрии и candidate thresholds. `median_mag_range` больше не смешивает разные фильтры: теперь это compatibility alias для `same_filter_max_median_delta`; смешанный диапазон сохраняется отдельно как `all_filter_median_range`, а диапазоны по каждому фильтру — в `same_filter_median_range_by_filter`.

Forced target отделён от автоматического candidate evidence: добавлены `auto_accepted_series_count` и `forced_target_series_count`, а `repeated_accepted` считается только по автоматическим каналам. Pair report публикует dependency-free Fisher-z p-values, Benjamini-Hochberg q-values и signed significance. Для `initial_only` добавлены `candidate_ensemble_policy_satisfied` и `candidate_ensemble_stop_status=POLICY_STOPPED`, поэтому штатная policy-stop больше не смешивается с математической сходимостью.


## Обновление 0.5.38.2 — 2026-08-04

Контрольные MASTER-серии `TIC13533330_01` показали 30–40 минут на 66 кадров. Manifest timings локализовали узкое место: два `compute_object_qc` прохода занимали около 20 минут, поскольку neighbor statistics вычислялись полным Python-перебором всех 18 916 Gaia sources против всех 18 916 sources. При этом science measurements существовали только для 819–827 объектов.

0.5.38.2 вычисляет точную spherical neighbor geometry только для measured source IDs против полного каталога векторизованными haversine-блоками NumPy и кэширует результат между повторными QC-проходами. Synthetic benchmark 18 916 × 827 занимает около 1.2 s на первый проход и около 0.004 s при cache hit. Добавлены phase timings и work provenance. При отрицательном target separation без explicit target resolver теперь завершается до DB-запросов.

MASTER B/V color calibration включена через stellar transformations Tonry et al. (2012), Table 6, из Pan-STARRS `g,r` в Johnson B/V с propagation photometric errors и transformation scatter. R/I behavior не меняется. Миграция БД не требуется.

Проверка упаковочной среды: `119 passed, 8 skipped`; compileall OK. Следующая обязательная проверка — повтор одной MASTER-серии и сравнение Object-QC flags/timings с 0.5.38.1.


## Обновление 0.5.38.3 — 2026-08-05

После 0.5.38.2 основным ограничением стали повторные чтения одного calibration layer через PostgreSQL/SQLAlchemy. 0.5.38.3 добавляет scalar `CalibrationAnalysisSnapshot`, который один раз загружает measurement rows, отдельно декодирует frame JSON один раз на кадр и строит object scatter вместе с measurement geometry. Один snapshot повторно используется Object QC, candidate triage, field report и random-error validation; process-local LRU ограничен двумя calibration layers.

`field_qc_report` больше не загружает scatter второй раз внутри `build_candidate_triage()`. Default bulk batch увеличен до 3000 строк с автоматическим bind-parameter cap. Добавлена обязательная миграция `scripts/migrate_mvp5_38_3_measurement_calibration_index.sql`, создающая calibration-first индекс `(calibration_version_id, object_id, frame_id)`. Photometric formulas и QC semantics не меняются. Упаковочная проверка: `125 passed, 8 skipped`; compileall OK.


## Обновление 0.5.38.4 — 2026-08-05

Контрольный MASTER-прогон 0.5.38.3 для `TIC1353333001\4316\EAST_V` (66 кадров, 50 565 точек) завершился за 456.8 s против 827.2 s до snapshot/index patch. Object QC и field reports перестали доминировать, но candidate-exclusion branch потратила около 63 s на повторную ensemble calibration, Object QC и field report при `requested_excluded_reference_objects=2` и `actually_excluded_reference_objects=0`.

0.5.38.4 сохраняет набор фактически используемых ensemble reference object IDs после каждого pass. Перед очередной candidate-excluded calibration requested exclusions пересекаются с текущим reference set. При пустом пересечении pipeline не создаёт новый calibration layer, не копирует measurements и не повторяет Object QC/field report; convergence получает `stop_status=NO_USABLE_REFERENCE_EXCLUSIONS` и `stop_reason=no_usable_reference_exclusions`. Фотометрические формулы, reference selection thresholds и candidate criteria не меняются. Миграция БД не требуется.


## Обновление 0.5.39.0 — schema contract foundation

Первый этап рефакторинга модели данных. SQLAlchemy metadata теперь описывает все 25 таблиц текущей рабочей схемы, включая ранее migration-only `fields`/`field_series`, pipeline provenance и event registry. `init-db` и `reset-db` создают и проверяют полный schema contract. Фотометрические формулы и pipeline products не меняются; migration существующей БД не требуется. Полное ТЗ: `docs/architecture/DATA_MODEL_REFACTOR_TZ.md`.


## Обновление 0.5.40.0 — normalized calibration terms

Фаза C рефакторинга модели данных начата в безопасном dual-write режиме. Добавлены `calibration_iterations`, `calibration_frame_terms` и `calibration_iteration_objects`. Aperture correction, aperture ZP, ensemble и color calibration продолжают создавать прежние materialized `measurements`, но одновременно сохраняют компактные коэффициенты, frame offsets/QC и object/reference membership. Внутренние sigma-clipping iterations не считаются отдельными научными продуктами; сохраняется pipeline-significant calibration pass и параметры inner solver. Команды `show-calibration-iterations` и `verify-calibration-terms` позволяют проверять новый слой на реальных сериях. Удаление legacy intermediate measurements в этом релизе запрещено.

## Обновление 0.5.40.1 — reconstruction parity gate

После реального MASTER-прогона 0.5.40.0 все четыре normalized calibration products дали `verify-calibration-terms: OK` с нулём несовпадений. 0.5.40.1 добавляет `verify-calibration-reconstruction`: итоговый calibration product реконструируется от immutable base forced photometry через normalized aperture correction, aperture ZP, ensemble и color terms и сравнивается с текущим materialized `measurements` по scalar photometric fields. Legacy JSON flags намеренно не входят в parity, поскольку именно их дублирование планируется удалить.

Color stage теперь сохраняет один `calibration_iteration_objects` row для каждого science object с exact applied reference/pivot color и object-level systematic uncertainty; ensemble normalized parameters явно сохраняют `prefer_mag_cal`. Миграция БД не требуется.


### 0.5.41.2 clean-rebuild auto-catalog reuse
When `process-archive-path` auto-generates a catalog name, a populated exact-name catalog already present in `catalog_sources` is now reused before any Gaia query. This supports Stage-3 clean rebuilds after `reset-derived-data`, which intentionally preserves catalog/object identity. New catalog namespaces still query Gaia.


## 0.5.41.3 — clean rebuild hardening

Batch runner 1.5.2 excludes copied observation directories with identical FITS filename/size signatures before queueing. New Gaia identity catalogs use a public TAP fallback chain (AIP -> ARI Heidelberg -> ESAC) while preserved exact-name local catalogs still bypass the network entirely. See `docs/releases/0.5.41.3.md` and the Russian user manual.


### 0.5.41.4 Gaia TAP/CSV compatibility hotfix

Public AIP and ARI Gaia DR3 mirrors are now queried with synchronous TAP `/sync` and explicit CSV output. This avoids the observed AIP HTTP 406 caused by astroquery TAP Accept negotiation and the ARI/Astropy Windows overflow while parsing 64-bit Gaia `source_id` from VOTable/BINARY. `source_id` is kept as exact decimal text. ESAC remains the last fallback. No schema or photometry change.

### 0.5.41.5 MASTER remote archive Stage 1A

Adds read-only `master-archive-search` against the remote MASTER `processed_frames` database and plan-first `master-archive-fetch` for raw/header/dark/flat artifacts. Internal `/master/...` paths are mapped to the confirmed `/data/master/...` HTTPS namespace and downloaded with HTTP Basic Auth, `.part`/Range resume, atomic rename, transient retry/backoff, deduplication of shared dark/flat files, skip-existing semantics and SHA-256 transfer provenance. The current GPX workflow defaults to `C:\master\gpx`. Raw calibration itself is intentionally not part of this release; that remains Stage 1B. No DB migration or Stage 2/Stage 3 photometric formula change.


### 0.5.41.6 MASTER archive HTTPS discovery fallback

`master-archive-search` now supports `--search-transport auto|postgres|http`. `auto` retains direct PostgreSQL discovery when allowed, but falls back to authenticated `master2/processing.php` when the MASTER server rejects the workstation through `pg_hba.conf`. HTTPS discovery parses the same processing-table rows, extracts raw/header paths, resolves referenced dark/flat raw IDs through `master2/index.php`, and emits the same inventory schema consumed by `master-archive-fetch`. No database migration, Stage 2 photometry, or Stage 3 calibration semantics change.


### 0.5.41.7 MASTER HTTPS coordinate-search hotfix

The first real 0.5.41.6 HTTPS smoke authenticated successfully but returned zero rows for a sky position that the MASTER web UI shows with many observations. HTTPS discovery no longer injects the pgSphere box through `where_long`; it now uses the public `coord2000` search field of `processing.php`, follows the normal web pagination, and applies the requested <=0.95 deg box, date range and filter constraints locally. Parser mismatch is now reported explicitly when frame paths are present but no result rows can be parsed. No database migration or photometric change.


### 0.5.41.8 MASTER HTTPS result-row parser hotfix

A real 0.5.41.7 GPX smoke reached a populated `processing.php` response containing MASTER raw paths, but the HTML parser returned no rows. The parser no longer requires the presentation-only `tr class="n"` marker or a fixed Raw column index. It collects table rows with nested-table-safe state, recognizes result rows by canonical raw-frame path signatures, locates Raw/Dark/Flat dynamically, and can recover raw/header paths from download/action links. Inventory/download schemas, database state, and photometric semantics are unchanged.


## Stage 3 M4 immutable inter-series persistence (0.5.46.0)

After real GPX_TF17 M1--M3 validation, Stage 3 can persist a graph solution as an immutable generation. Run the managed DB migration first, then use `persist-interseries-calibration`, `show-interseries-calibration`, and `verify-interseries-calibration`. The M4 fingerprint contains exact Stage-2 SCIENCE calibration IDs plus all M1--M3 scientific parameters. Identical inputs are idempotent; changed inputs create a new generation.

The old `interseries_calibration_offsets` table remains a legacy compatibility layer and is not populated by M4. `REDUNDANT_GRAPH_OK` marks a graph with closure redundancy; a tree is marked `SPARSE_GRAPH_NO_CLOSURE` and requires explicit `--allow-sparse-graph`. Series offset uncertainty remains correlated and is not folded into every Stage-2 measurement. M5 object-history consumption is intentionally deferred.

## Stage 3 M5 global object light curve (0.5.47.0)

`export-global-object-light-curve` reads exact Stage-2 `SCIENCE` rows linked by immutable M4 generations and exports a stitched object history without writing new measurements to the database. The main CSV is never downsampled: `mag_global = mag_science + z_s`, Stage-2 random/systematic terms remain separate, and `mag_err_series_zp` is retained as a correlated per-series zero-point uncertainty. Automatic M4 selection is allowed only when a scope has exactly one unambiguous persisted generation; otherwise use repeatable `--generation-id`. A current SCIENCE generation that is not the exact M4 source blocks export unless `--allow-partial` is explicit.

The same command can create one plot per filter using the existing headless Matplotlib infrastructure. `--plot-reduction auto` keeps raw accepted points while the exact linked source-row count stays within `--plot-max-points` (default 5000 per filter) and otherwise conservatively switches only the plot layer to streaming per-series time bins with a mean, random/bin SEM and min/max envelope. The exact CSV is unaffected. Explicit `--plot-bin-minutes`, `--plot-reduction bin|none`, `--no-plots`, and PNG/PDF/SVG output are supported. Filters are never merged onto one magnitude scale. No DB migration is required for 0.5.47.0.

## M5 rejection diagnostics hotfix (0.5.47.1)

0.5.47.1 does not weaken the Stage-2/M5 QC policy. It makes an all-rejected export explicit instead of silently producing a header-only CSV with no plots. The M5 summary now contains `status`, aggregate `rejection_reasons`, and per-series rejection counts. `--include-rejected-debug` writes a separate `*_rejections.csv` containing the rejected rows, exact SCIENCE/M4 provenance, merged quality flags and reject reasons. The CLI prints rejection counts and returns exit code 2 when exact M4-linked rows exist but none survive QC. Plots remain accepted-only, so no image is produced for an all-rejected object.

The first GPX smoke object `object_id=29700` is intentionally rejected by the existing QC: its Stage-3 object states contain `HIGH_RMS`, `LARGE_CATALOG_MAG_RESIDUAL`, `POSSIBLE_PROPER_MOTION_MISMATCH`, `SATURATED_LIKE`, plus NO/WEAK detection support. This is not an M4 linkage failure. A clean six-series control from the same baseline is `object_id=29786`.


## M5 strict plot budget and compressed time axis (0.5.47.2)

0.5.47.2 keeps the exact M5 CSV unchanged but makes `--plot-max-points` a hard per-filter ceiling for binned visualization. Per-series bins are allocated with a largest-remainder budget and the inclusive final MJD is clamped into the allocated last bin, fixing the real GPX `20 -> 21` plot-point overrun. `--plot-time-axis auto|continuous|compressed` adds a display-only compressed time axis: large empty gaps between observing series are shortened and marked `//`, while original MJD values remain in the main and plot-data CSV files. The default is `auto`. Above 12 series the renderer automatically switches from the detailed series-colored/legend mode to an archive-overview style with one filter-level visual style and no per-series legend. No DB migration.

## M8 too-small batch hotfix (0.5.48.1)

The first real full-root M8 plan found two NEW leaf batches that cannot satisfy the frozen `min_frames_per_series=10` recipe (2018-09-08: 6 FITS total; 2018-10-02: 3 FITS). M8 now classifies such NEW/INCOMPLETE batches as `SKIP_TOO_SMALL` before Stage 2 using conservative scanner series-like grouping. No scientific or DB semantics changed.

## M8 resumable field-archive orchestration (0.5.48.0)

`process-field-archive` turns the validated manual scale workflow into one native resume-safe command. It partitions a processed root into FITS leaf batches, skips READY batches, resumes incomplete batches through the existing idempotent Stage-2 pipeline, verifies newly selected SCIENCE materialization and catalog identity, runs explicit M0--M4 policies, verifies the immutable generations, exports optional M5 controls and writes a consolidated JSON/HTML/CSV report bundle. Scientific thresholds are explicit (`--stage3-policy V:15:76`, `--stage3-policy R:20:77` in the GPX_TF17 validation) and are never relaxed automatically. No DB migration or Stage-2/M0--M5 scientific formula change.

## M5 epoch-level saturation rejection (0.5.47.3)

0.5.47.3 fixes a real GPX_TF17 scale-up QC semantic bug in `export-global-object-light-curve`. `SATURATED_LIKE` is an Object-QC/series-level diagnostic meaning that an object had at least one saturated or near-saturated epoch. M5 previously inherited the generic reject set and therefore rejected every row of that series. The default M5 policy now keeps `SATURATED_LIKE` as diagnostic provenance and rejects only rows whose measurement-level `SATURATED_OR_NEAR_SATURATED` flag is active. Explicit `--extra-reject-flags SATURATED_LIKE` restores the old strict behavior when deliberately requested. Stage 2, `DEFAULT_REJECT_FLAGS`, candidate/reference selection, M1-M4, database schema, magnitudes and error semantics are unchanged.


## Productization P1: installed package resources (0.5.49.0)

0.5.49.0 removes the first confirmed wheel/sdist blocker without changing scientific behavior. Built-in MASTER/RoboPhot profiles and SQL migration resources are now shipped inside `grandgousier.resources`; default runtime lookup no longer assumes a repository checkout containing top-level `configs/` and `scripts/`. Root copies remain for compatibility and are parity-tested against the packaged copies. Wheel/sdist and outside-checkout resource smoke were validated; no DB migration is required.

# MVP5.30.7 — smarter field-series resolver for field-qc-report

Patch goal: make `field-qc-report --field-series-name` robust when the stored `field_series` row was created under an older pipeline prefix, while the user now passes a newer derived calibration prefix.

## Problem fixed

After MVP5.30.6, `field-qc-report --series-id 1` correctly restricted the report to the 18 frames of the persistent series. But this command failed:

```powershell
python -m grandgousier.cli field-qc-report `
  --field-series-name master_test_20230919_s1_v30 `
  --calibration-name master_test_20230919_s1_v30_ps1_i_color_v1 `
  --catalog-name gaia_dr3_master `
  --out reports\check_05306_series_filtered.json
```

because the database stored the actual series as:

```text
series_id = 1
field_name = TIC420268415_01
last_calibration_prefix = master_test_20230919_s1_v27
```

The user-facing prefix `master_test_20230919_s1_v30` existed in the derived calibration name, but not in the `field_series` row.

## Changes

- Version bumped to `0.5.30.7`.
- `field-qc-report --field-series-name` now accepts calibration-related names more reliably.
- Resolver now builds aliases from the target calibration and its source-calibration chain, for example:
  - `master_test_20230919_s1_v30_ps1_i_color_v1`;
  - `master_test_20230919_s1_v30`;
  - `master_test_20230919_s1_v27_ensemble_g_v1`;
  - `master_test_20230919_s1_v27`.
- If no literal series match is found, the resolver can fall back to frame overlap between `measurements.calibration_version_id` and `field_series_frames`.
- The overlap fallback is only enabled when the supplied name is plausibly related to the target/source calibration chain, so a random typo does not silently select an unrelated series.
- Missing-series errors now include a compact list of available `field_series` values with `series_id`, `series_uid`, `field_name`, `n_frames`, `last_calibration_prefix`, and `primary_object_name` when available.
- Added regression tests for:
  - resolving a new derived prefix through calibration-frame overlap;
  - resolving a new derived prefix through an older source pipeline prefix;
  - showing available series instead of a bare `ValueError`.

## Expected command

```powershell
python -m grandgousier.cli field-qc-report `
  --field-series-name master_test_20230919_s1_v30 `
  --calibration-name master_test_20230919_s1_v30_ps1_i_color_v1 `
  --catalog-name gaia_dr3_master `
  --out reports\check_05307_series_filtered_by_name.json
```

Expected report metadata:

```text
frame_selection_mode = field_series
series_id = 1
selected_frame_ids_count = 18
n_frames = 18
```

`APERTURE_UNSTABLE` and `APERTURE_MEDIAN_SHIFT` should remain visible in `object_qc.flag_counts`.

## Checks

```powershell
python -m compileall grandgousier tests
python -m pytest -q
```

Expected in the patch build:

```text
19 passed, 2 skipped
```

## MVP5.30.8 — pipeline idempotency audit

Patch `0.5.30.8` adds a read-only idempotency audit for repeated `run-field-pipeline` executions.

New command:

```powershell
python -m grandgousier.cli pipeline-idempotency-report `
  --field-series-name master_test_20230919_s1_v30 `
  --calibration-name master_test_20230919_s1_v30_ps1_i_color_v1 `
  --catalog-name gaia_dr3_master `
  --out reports\check_05308_idempotency.json
```

The audit checks logical duplicate identities in:

- `measurements`: `object_id, frame_id, calibration_version_id`;
- `object_qc`: `object_id, catalog_name, instrument_unit_id, calibration_version_id, algorithm`;
- `source_detections`: `frame_id, algorithm, rounded x/y position`;
- `detection_catalog_matches`: `frame_id, catalog_source_id, catalog_name, algorithm`;
- `frame_qc`: `frame_id, catalog_name, algorithm`;
- `event_detection_links`: `event_id, source_detection_id` when the event-detection layer exists.

The command returns exit code `0` for OK/WARNING and `2` when real duplicate violations are found. `MISSING` checks are used for optional tables such as `event_detection_links` when the corresponding migration has not been applied.

This patch does not change existing science tables and does not require a DB migration. It is a diagnostic guard before and after repeated pipeline runs.

The migration adds:

This table stores one future offset per calibration/series/algorithm/reference. The current patch does not compute offsets yet. If no row exists for a light-curve point, `mag_global = mag_cal`, `interseries_offset_mag = null`, and `interseries_offset_status = NO_INTERSERIES_OFFSET`.

# Grandgousier 0.5.31.1 — one-command archive path processing

This patch adds a human-facing orchestration command for normal archive work.
Instead of manually calling `index-archive`, `build-field-series`, `run-field-pipeline`
and `light-curve-summary`, a user can pass a directory with FITS files and let
Grandgousier plan or execute the standard workflow.

## New command

```powershell
python -m grandgousier.cli process-archive-path `
  --path "D:\archive\field_or_night" `
  --catalog-name gaia_dr3_master
```

Without `--execute` this is a safe plan-only run. It scans `.fits/.fit/.fts`, reads
headers, auto-detects `MASTER` or `RoboPhot`, and prints the planned file groups.

Real execution:

```powershell
python -m grandgousier.cli process-archive-path `
  --path "D:\archive\field_or_night" `
  --catalog-name gaia_dr3_master `
  --execute `
  --manifest-out reports\process_archive_manifest.json
```

Execution performs:

```text
scan headers
-> auto-detect instrument profile
-> index frames
-> build field_series
-> run-field-pipeline for new series
-> write per-series light-curve summary JSON
-> optional run manifest JSON
```

## Auto profile detection

The command supports:

```text
--instrument-profile auto
--instrument-profile MASTER
--instrument-profile RoboPhot
```

`auto` uses FITS-header signals and the existing YAML profiles:

```text
configs/master.yaml
configs/robophot.yaml
```

Profile paths can be overridden with:

```text
--master-profile
--robophot-profile
```

## Defaults

The high-level command uses the current standard pipeline defaults:

```text
aperture_radius_pix = 3
annulus_inner_pix = 8
annulus_outer_pix = 12
min_frames_per_series = 10
max_series_gap_minutes = 60
```

These remain overridable for debugging.

## New code

```text
grandgousier/archive/auto_process.py
grandgousier/io/archive_indexer.py: index_archive_paths()
grandgousier/cli.py: process-archive-path
tests/test_process_archive_path.py
```

## Version

```text
0.5.31.0 -> 0.5.31.1
```

No database migration is required.

# Grandgousier 0.5.31.2 — process-archive-path test hotfix

Patch-level hotfix for the one-command archive processing patch.

## What changed

- Bumped version to `0.5.31.2`.
- Fixed `tests/test_process_archive_path.py`: the fake SQLAlchemy query object now implements `one_or_none()`.
- No production behavior or database schema changes.
- No migration required.

## Why

`index_archive_paths()` creates or resolves an `InstrumentUnit` through SQLAlchemy's `one_or_none()` path. The regression test used a lightweight `FakeQuery` object that implemented `first()` but not `one_or_none()`, so the test failed even though the production SQLAlchemy query path is valid.

# MVP5.31.3 — process-archive-path safety and auto-catalog patch

Patch `0.5.31.3` hardens the one-command archive workflow introduced in `0.5.31.1`.

## Changes

1. `process-archive-path` now restricts field-series construction to frame ids that came from the current `--path`. It no longer processes old unrelated `field_series` from the same `instrument_unit_id`.
2. `build-field-series` accepts an optional `frame_ids` selection.
3. `--catalog-name` is now optional for `process-archive-path`. If omitted, Grandgousier generates an `auto_catalog_*` identity catalog name from FITS group metadata.
4. When an auto catalog is used in `--execute` mode, the command tries to query Gaia DR3 for the indexed frame ids before running the pipeline.
5. Auto Gaia query can be disabled with `--no-auto-catalog-query`.
6. Manifest now includes `indexed_frame_ids`, `created_series_ids`, `processed_series_ids`, `catalog_results`, and per-pipeline `science_status`.
7. A technically successful pipeline with zero light-curve points is reported as `DONE_WITH_WARNINGS` at the `process-archive-path` level, with `science_status=WARNING_NO_MEASUREMENTS`.

## Typical usage

Plan only:

```powershell
python -m grandgousier.cli process-archive-path `
  --path "D:\archive\robophot_field" `
  --manifest-out reports\process_plan.json
```

Execute with auto catalog:

```powershell
python -m grandgousier.cli process-archive-path `
  --path "D:\archive\robophot_field" `
  --execute `
  --manifest-out reports\process_execute.json
```

Execute with an existing catalog:

```powershell
python -m grandgousier.cli process-archive-path `
  --path "D:\archive\robophot_field" `
  --catalog-name gaia_dr3_master `
  --execute
```

## Verification

```powershell
python -c "import grandgousier; print(grandgousier.__version__)"
python -m compileall grandgousier tests
python -m pytest -q
```

Expected version: `0.5.31.3`.

No database migration is required.

# MVP 5.31.4 — safer auto-catalog execution

This patch improves the `process-archive-path` auto-catalog path after a RoboPhot run exposed two practical issues: Gaia/astroquery may stall before the first per-frame query finishes, and a failed auto catalog should not be followed by the full heavy pipeline.

Changes:

- Version bumped to `0.5.31.4`.
- `process-archive-path` auto catalog now defaults to `--auto-catalog-query-mode frame_union`, one cone for the whole input field.
- Added `--auto-catalog-query-mode {frame_union,per_frame}`.
- Added `--auto-catalog-max-radius-deg` to prevent accidentally huge Gaia queries from bad WCS.
- Added `--auto-catalog-timeout-sec` as a best-effort astroquery timeout.
- Added `--allow-empty-catalog` for explicit debugging; without it a failed/empty auto catalog stops before pipeline stages.
- `query-gaia-for-frames` also accepts `--query-mode`, `--max-radius-deg`, and `--gaia-timeout-sec`.
- Manifest/catalog summary includes query mode, queried cones, read rows, and skipped oversized cones.
- Added tests for the catalog precondition and Gaia cone union helper.

No database migration is required.

# MVP5.31.5 — auto-catalog footprint fallback

This patch improves `process-archive-path` auto-catalog bootstrapping for frames
that have indexed pointing coordinates but no complete celestial WCS in the raw
FITS header.

Changes:

- Gaia auto-catalog cone generation now prefers the full FITS WCS when present.
- If no celestial WCS is available, it falls back to `frames.ra_center_deg`,
  `frames.dec_center_deg` and `instrument_units.pixel_scale_arcsec` plus FITS
  image dimensions.
- Catalog summary output now exposes `failed_frames`, `skipped_missing_file`,
  and `skipped_oversized_cones`.

# MVP5.31.8 — DB-centered Gaia footprint diagnostics

Patch version: `0.5.31.8`

This patch fixes and instruments Gaia auto-catalog footprint construction used by
`process-archive-path`.

## What changed

- Gaia footprint construction now prefers the indexed DB pointing center:
  `frames.ra_center_deg` / `frames.dec_center_deg`.
- FITS WCS is no longer a hard precondition for building a Gaia cone.
- FITS header `CD*` / `CDELT*` and instrument profile pixel scale are used for
  footprint radius estimation.
- `CRVAL1/CRVAL2` and RoboPhot `ALPHA/DELTA` are only fallback centers.
- Gaia query result now records:
  - `failed_footprint_reasons`
  - `sample_failed_footprints`
- `process-archive-path` manifest and summary now include footprint failure reasons.

## Why

RoboPhot frames can have valid indexed centers in the database while FITS WCS
footprint calculation is fragile. The previous code could report
`queried_frames=0`, `queried_cones=0`, `failed_frames=N` without explaining the
actual failed precondition.

# MVP5.31.9 — large-catalog batching and faster detection matching

Patch version: `0.5.31.9`

This patch makes the field pipeline safe for large Gaia auto-catalogs, including
RoboPhot fields where `process-archive-path` can import ten thousand or more
catalog sources.

## What changed

- Added shared PostgreSQL-safe bulk chunking helpers:
  - `grandgousier.db.bulk`
  - `grandgousier.db.measurement_io`
- Batched multi-row INSERT/UPSERT writes for:
  - forced-aperture `measurements`
  - aperture-ZP derived `measurements`
  - ensemble derived `measurements`
  - preliminary frame-QC calibrated `measurements`
  - `frame_catalog_links`
  - `source_detections`
  - `detection_catalog_matches`
  - `object_qc`
- Default batch size is 1000 rows and is also capped by the PostgreSQL bind
  parameter limit with safety headroom.
- Added `insert_batches` / `insert_batch_size` result diagnostics where relevant.
- Added `--bulk-insert-batch-size` to:
  - `process-archive-path`
  - `run-field-pipeline`
  - `run-forced-photometry`
  - calibration commands that copy measurement rows.
- Optimized detection-to-catalog matching with a conservative pixel-grid
  prefilter.  Final acceptance is still done by sky-coordinate separation.

## Why

The RoboPhot test run successfully created an auto Gaia catalog with 13,159
sources, but then failed during forced photometry because one huge multi-row
`INSERT INTO measurements` exceeded PostgreSQL/psycopg's bind-parameter limit:

```text
number of parameters must be between 0 and 65535
```

A single measurement row uses many bound parameters, so large catalogs must be
written in chunks.  The same issue can appear later in derived calibration and
QC tables, so this patch applies batching to the full field-pipeline write path
rather than only the immediate failing statement.

## Verification

```powershell
python -c "import grandgousier; print(grandgousier.__version__)"
python -m compileall grandgousier tests
python -m pytest -q
```

Expected version:

```text
0.5.31.9
```

Re-run the same RoboPhot command:

```powershell
python -m grandgousier.cli process-archive-path `
  --path "C:\PycharmProjects\GPX\photometry\obs\robophot\2023-11-05 GPX-TF16E-48\i" `
  --execute `
  --auto-catalog-mag-limit 20.5 `
  --auto-catalog-timeout-sec 120 `
  --auto-catalog-max-radius-deg 1.0 `
  --manifest-out reports\check_05319_process_execute.json
```

Expected change relative to `0.5.31.8`: no failure with PostgreSQL bind-parameter
limit during `Forced aperture photometry`.

## Архивный источник: `README_MVP5_32_0_STAGED_OPTIMIZED_PHOTOMETRY_PATCH.md`

# MVP5.32.0 — staged optimized photometry, pre-QC and working catalog

This patch addresses the RoboPhot large-catalog execution problem observed after
`0.5.31.9`: the Gaia footprint and batched inserts worked, but the path pipeline
still ran several full forced-photometry passes and used an overly deep working
catalog.

## What changed

1. **Pre-photometry frame QC**

   New module: `grandgousier.quality.frame_pre_qc`.

   The pipeline now reads each FITS frame before forced photometry and stores a
   compact diagnostic block in `frames.quality_flags["frame_pre_photometry_qc_v1"]`:

   - `n_local_maxima_before_cap`
   - `DETECTION_CAP_REACHED`
   - background median/MAD sigma and percentiles
   - bright-pixel fraction
   - BAD/WARNING/OK severity

   This resolves the ambiguity where `source_detections=2000` only meant that the
   detector save cap was reached, not that exactly 2000 real sources existed.

2. **Working catalog limits**

   `process-archive-path` now separates the deep Gaia identity catalog from the
   practical forced-photometry working set.  Defaults:

   ```text
   --working-catalog-mag-limit 19.0
   --max-working-sources-per-frame 2000
   --catalog-edge-margin-pix 20
   ```

   Existing `frame_catalog_links` for the same frame/catalog are replaced before
   inserting the new working links.

3. **Calibration-name isolation**

   Calibration versions include a working-set tag such as
   `_work_g19_max2000_edge20_`.  This prevents a rerun with a smaller working set
   from accidentally reusing older `G<20.5` raw measurement layers.

4. **Raw photometry reuse**

   `run_forced_aperture_photometry` can skip frames whose target raw calibration
   already has enough measurements.  Use `--force-recompute-photometry` to force a
   replacement computation.

5. **Expensive branches disabled by default in one-command processing**

   In `process-archive-path`, the detection branch and aperture-stability sweep
   are now opt-in:

   ```text
   --enable-detection-branch
   --enable-aperture-stability-qc
   ```

6. **Stage timing in manifests**

   Pipeline steps now include `elapsed_sec` and are copied into the
   `process-archive-path` manifest.

## Database migration

No migration is required.  The patch uses existing tables and JSONB fields.

## Suggested RoboPhot command

```powershell
python -m grandgousier.cli process-archive-path `
  --path "C:\PycharmProjects\GPX\photometry\obs\robophot\2023-11-05 GPX-TF16E-48\i" `
  --execute `
  --auto-catalog-mag-limit 20.5 `
  --working-catalog-mag-limit 19.0 `
  --max-working-sources-per-frame 2000 `
  --catalog-edge-margin-pix 20 `
  --auto-catalog-timeout-sec 120 `
  --auto-catalog-max-radius-deg 1.0 `
  --manifest-out reports\check_05320_process_execute.json
```

## Архивный источник: `README_MVP5_32_1_PRE_QC_EXCLUSION_GUARD_PATCH.md`

# Grandgousier 0.5.32.1 — pre-QC exclusion guard

Patch over 0.5.32.0. No database migration is required.

## Fix

When `--exclude-bad-pre-qc-frames` rejected all selected frames, the runner converted the empty explicit frame list to `None` for later stages. Low-level stages interpret `None` as "all frames for the instrument unit", so the pipeline accidentally continued on unrelated/current series frames.

0.5.32.1 keeps an empty frame selection explicit and stops the pipeline before catalog matching/photometry when no usable frames remain. The run is recorded as `DONE_NO_SCIENCE_FRAMES` with `science_status=BAD_FRAME_QC`, not as a crash.

## Expected behavior

For a fully icy series with `--exclude-bad-pre-qc-frames`:

```text
check_wcs -> DONE
pre_photometry_frame_qc -> DONE, remaining_frames=0
stop_no_usable_frames -> DONE
process status -> DONE_WITH_WARNINGS
science_status -> BAD_FRAME_QC
```

No catalog-to-frame matching or forced photometry should start after all frames are rejected.

# Grandgousier 0.5.32.2 — quality flag policy patch

Patch over 0.5.32.1.

## Purpose

This patch separates diagnostic detection-support flags from hard science-light-curve rejection policy.

`NO_DETECTION_SUPPORT` and `WEAK_DETECTION_SUPPORT` remain object-level QC diagnostics. They are used as hard rejection flags only when detection-to-catalog matching is enabled, or when the user explicitly requests it.

## Changes

- `process-archive-path` now accepts:
  - `--require-detection-support`
  - `--no-require-detection-support`
- Default policy:
  - with `--enable-detection-branch`: `require_detection_support_effective=true`
  - without detection branch: `require_detection_support_effective=false`
- Pipeline manifests now include `quality_policy` with:
  - `detection_branch_enabled`
  - `detection_matching_executed`
  - `detection_matches_count`
  - `require_detection_support_requested`
  - `require_detection_support_effective`
- Field QC report metadata/summary now records the effective detection-support policy.
- Science light-curve summaries can exclude detection-support flags from reject flags while keeping other QC rejections active.
- If detection branch is enabled and detection matching runs but produces zero matches, the science status becomes `WARNING_NO_DETECTION_MATCHES`.

## Expected behavior

- Forced-photometry-only runs no longer reject every point merely because detection support was not computed.
- Runs with `--enable-detection-branch` keep the strict detection-support veto by default.
- Explicit CLI flags can override the default policy.

## Validation

Run:

```powershell
python -m compileall grandgousier tests
python -m pytest -q
```

Recommended control checks:

```powershell
# Strict detection-supported run remains OK
python -m grandgousier.cli process-archive-path `
  --path "C:\Users\nikita\Desktop\28.03.2026\CALIBRATED\i" `
  --execute `
  --catalog-name "auto_catalog_robophot_20260402_BK_Lyn_i" `
  --working-catalog-mag-limit 19.0 `
  --max-working-sources-per-frame 2000 `
  --catalog-edge-margin-pix 20 `
  --exclude-bad-pre-qc-frames `
  --enable-detection-branch `

# Forced-photometry-only run should no longer collapse to accepted_points=0 solely due to detection-support flags
python -m grandgousier.cli process-archive-path `
  --path "C:\Users\nikita\Desktop\02.04.2026\CALIBRATED\i" `
  --execute `
```

# Grandgousier 0.5.32.3 — target object handling

This patch makes the field target an explicit pipeline product instead of relying
on the RMS-outlier candidate list.

## Why

BK Lyn is the science target of the processed RoboPhot series.  It has a real
light curve and clean object QC, but it may not exceed the generic field
`rms_excess >= 2` candidate threshold.  A pointed target must therefore be
reported independently and must not be used as an ensemble reference star.

## Changes

- `process-archive-path` adds target controls:
  - `--target-source-id`
  - `--target-object-id`
  - `--target-max-sep-arcsec`
  - `--no-target-light-curve`
- The pipeline resolves a field target after raw/aperture-ZP measurements exist:
  - explicit internal `object_id`, if provided;
  - explicit external/catalog `source_id`, if provided;
  - otherwise, nearest measured catalog object to the mean frame centre.
- The resolved target is excluded from ensemble reference-object selection.
- Ensemble measurement flags now record:
  - `ensemble_object_excluded_from_reference`
  - `ensemble_reference_exclusion_reason`
- Object QC marks the target with `FIELD_TARGET` and records target metadata in
  `object_qc.details.target`.
- Field candidate triage always includes the resolved target as a target-origin
  candidate, even if it is not an RMS-excess outlier.
- Candidate CSV gains:
  - `candidate_origin`
  - `is_target`
  - `target_reason`
- Field QC summary includes target-candidate counts.
- The pipeline exports:
  - `<prefix>_target_light_curve.csv`
  - `<prefix>_target_light_curve.json`
- The manifest and `quality_policy` include the resolved target identifiers and
  target light-curve paths.

## Expected BK Lyn behavior

BK Lyn should appear in the field candidate triage with `candidate_origin=target`
and `is_target=True`, and its target light curve should be exported even if the
object is not selected by the generic RMS-excess threshold.

No database migration is required.

## Архивный источник: `README_MVP5_32_4_TARGET_FRAME_SCOPE_FIX_PATCH.md`

# Grandgousier 0.5.32.4 — target light-curve frame-scope fix

This patch fixes a regression introduced in 0.5.32.3 target-object handling.

## Problem

`process-archive-path` runs field pipelines with both:

- `series_id`, used for provenance and field-series linkage;
- explicit `frame_ids`, used to keep processing restricted to the FITS files from the requested path.

The target light-curve export passed both selectors to `load_science_light_curve_rows()`. The public light-curve scope resolver correctly rejects this ambiguous combination with:

```text
ValueError: field_series selectors cannot be combined with explicit frame_ids
```

As a result, runs with `--target-source-id` failed after object QC, before writing target products and the final field report.

## Fix

`export_target_light_curve_product()` now prefers the explicit `frame_ids` scope whenever it is provided and does not also pass `series_id` to the light-curve scope resolver.

This preserves the safer path-scoped behavior of `process-archive-path` while still allowing series-level target export when no explicit frame list is supplied.

## Database migration

No database migration is required.

## Архивный источник: `README_MVP5_32_5_INTRINSIC_VARIABILITY_CANDIDATES_PATCH.md`

# MVP5 0.5.32.5 — intrinsic variability candidates

This patch extends candidate triage beyond pure RMS-excess outliers.

## Why

A scientifically interesting object can be clearly variable relative to its own
formal photometric errors, while not being a strong outlier in the field
RMS--magnitude diagram. BK Lyn is the motivating example: it should be surfaced
as a candidate even when it is not explicitly provided as the field target.

## Changes

- Adds an intrinsic-variability candidate channel.
- Keeps the existing RMS-excess channel.
- Keeps forced target candidates from 0.5.32.3/0.5.32.4.
- Candidate origin is now explicit in CSV/JSON via `candidate_origin`.
- New CSV diagnostics:
  - `rms_over_mag_err`
  - `mad_over_mag_err`
  - `effective_mag_err_median`
  - `intrinsic_variability_score`
  - `is_target`
  - `target_reason`
- Field report summary now separates:
  - `rms_excess_candidates`
  - `intrinsic_variability_candidates`
  - `intrinsic_only_candidates`
  - `target_candidates`

## Default intrinsic thresholds

- `min_intrinsic_rms = 0.03` mag
- `min_rms_over_mag_err = 2.0`
- `min_mad_over_mag_err = 1.5`
- `intrinsic_mag_err_floor = 0.01` mag

Use negative values in CLI options to disable individual numeric thresholds.

## Database migration

No database migration is required.

## Архивный источник: `README_MVP5_32_6_INTRINSIC_VARIABILITY_STRICT_PATCH.md`

# MVP5 0.5.32.6 — strict intrinsic variability candidates

This patch tightens the intrinsic-variability candidate channel introduced in 0.5.32.5.

## Why

The first intrinsic channel correctly recovered BK Lyn without target forcing, but the default thresholds were too permissive: many field objects passed because formal `mag_err` underestimates the full systematic scatter. The channel should find objects that are internally significant and robustly variable, not single-frame outliers or mild systematics.

## Changes

- Makes the tested strict thresholds the defaults:
  - `min_rms_over_mag_err = 4.0`
  - `min_mad_over_mag_err = 2.5`
  - `min_intrinsic_rms = 0.03 mag`
  - `intrinsic_mag_err_floor = 0.01 mag`
- Adds a robust amplitude gate for intrinsic candidates:
  - `robust_peak_to_peak = P90(mag) - P10(mag)`
  - default `min_robust_peak_to_peak = 0.08 mag`
- Exposes robust amplitude diagnostics in object scatter and candidate CSV/JSON:
  - `mag_p10`
  - `mag_p90`
  - `robust_peak_to_peak`
- Adds CLI options:
  - `--min-robust-peak-to-peak`
  - `--field-report-min-robust-peak-to-peak`
- Fixes unresolved target metadata:
  - when `target_resolved=false`, `target_object_id`, `target_catalog_source_id`, and `target_sep_arcsec` are reported as `null`;
  - the nearest unresolved auto-target candidate is reported separately as `nearest_target_candidate_*`.

## Expected BK Lyn behavior

With no explicit target and strict intrinsic thresholds, BK Lyn should still appear as an accepted candidate via:

```text
candidate_origin = intrinsic_variability
is_target = false
```

## Database migration

No database migration is required.

## Архивный источник: `README_MVP5_32_7_LOW_AMPLITUDE_INTRINSIC_PATCH.md`

# MVP5 0.5.32.7 — low-amplitude intrinsic variability candidates

This patch adds a separate candidate-triage channel for weak but coherent variables.

## Motivation

The strict intrinsic-variability channel introduced in 0.5.32.6 is useful for high-S/N variables, but it can miss lower-amplitude objects such as BK Lyn on nights where the field-level RMS envelope is high and `mag_rms / mag_err` remains below the strong intrinsic threshold.

## Changes

- Added candidate origin `low_amplitude_intrinsic`.
- Kept the strong intrinsic channel unchanged:
  - `min_intrinsic_rms = 0.03`
  - `min_rms_over_mag_err = 4.0`
  - `min_mad_over_mag_err = 2.5`
  - `min_robust_peak_to_peak = 0.08`
- Added default low-amplitude intrinsic thresholds:
  - `low_amplitude_min_measurements = 30`
  - `low_amplitude_min_intrinsic_rms = 0.03`
  - `low_amplitude_min_rms_over_mag_err = 2.3`
  - `low_amplitude_min_mad_over_mag_err = 2.0`
  - `low_amplitude_min_robust_peak_to_peak = 0.08`
- Strong intrinsic candidates are not duplicated as low-amplitude candidates.
- Field QC summaries now include:
  - `low_amplitude_intrinsic_candidates`
  - `low_amplitude_only_candidates`
- Candidate origins can now be:
  - `rms_excess`
  - `intrinsic_variability`
  - `low_amplitude_intrinsic`
  - `target`
  - comma-separated combinations of these origins.
- Added CLI controls for candidate triage, field QC reports, field pipelines, and `process-archive-path`.

## Notes

The usual object-QC rejection filters still apply after candidate generation. In detection-branch mode, low-amplitude intrinsic candidates are still rejected if detection support is weak and `require_detection_support` is effective.

No database migration is required.

# Grandgousier 0.5.33.0 — candidate-excluded ensemble second pass

Adds an opt-in two-pass ensemble calibration mode for field pipelines.

## New CLI flag

```text
--exclude-candidates-from-ensemble
```

The flag is available for:

- `field-pipeline`
- `process-archive-path`

## Behaviour

1. Run the normal aperture-ZP and initial ensemble calibration.
2. Compute object QC and the first field candidate triage.
3. Collect accepted candidate `object_id` values, plus any explicitly resolved target object.
4. Run a second ensemble calibration from the same aperture-ZP input, excluding those objects from the reference set.
5. Recompute object QC, field candidate triage, target light curve and candidate exports against the second-pass ensemble calibration.

The first-pass ensemble remains in the database. The final pipeline calibration name points to the second-pass calibration when the second pass is executed.

## Manifest additions

`quality_policy` now includes:

```text
candidate_ensemble_exclusion_enabled
candidate_ensemble_exclusion_executed
candidate_ensemble_excluded_object_ids
candidate_ensemble_excluded_objects
initial_ensemble_calibration
final_ensemble_calibration
```

Pipeline outputs include:

```text
ensemble_initial_calibration
ensemble_candidate_excluded_calibration
```

No DB migration is required.

# Grandgousier 0.5.33.1 — candidate-excluded ensemble provenance and iterations

This patch stabilizes the candidate-excluded ensemble mode introduced in 0.5.33.0.

## Changes

- Adds `--candidate-ensemble-max-iterations` to:
  - `field-pipeline`
  - `process-archive-path`
- Default is `2`, which preserves the 0.5.33.0 behavior: initial ensemble pass plus one candidate-excluded pass.
- Values above 2 allow iterative candidate-excluded ensemble calibration:
  - pass 1: normal ensemble and candidate triage;
  - pass 2: excludes accepted candidates from pass 1;
  - pass 3+: excludes the cumulative accepted candidates from previous passes until the limit is reached or no new exclusions appear.
- Adds explicit requested-vs-actual exclusion provenance:
  - requested excluded object IDs: all accepted candidates and target objects requested for reference exclusion;
  - actual excluded reference object IDs: the subset that would otherwise have been used as ensemble reference objects.
- Keeps 0.5.33.0 manifest aliases for compatibility, but adds unambiguous fields.

## New manifest / quality policy fields

```text
candidate_ensemble_max_iterations
candidate_ensemble_exclusion_iterations_executed
candidate_ensemble_requested_excluded_object_ids
candidate_ensemble_requested_excluded_objects
candidate_ensemble_actual_excluded_reference_object_ids
candidate_ensemble_actual_excluded_reference_objects
candidate_ensemble_exclusion_history
```

## New ensemble result fields

```text
requested_excluded_reference_object_ids
requested_excluded_reference_objects
actually_excluded_reference_object_ids
actually_excluded_reference_objects
```

The legacy `excluded_reference_object_ids` / `excluded_reference_objects` fields now refer to actual reference exclusions. The requested set is available in the new `requested_*` fields.

## Database migration

No database migration is required.

## Архивный источник: `README_MVP5_33_2_CANDIDATE_ENSEMBLE_UNTIL_CONVERGED_PATCH.md`

# Grandgousier 0.5.33.2 — candidate-excluded ensemble until convergence

Patch-only update on top of 0.5.33.1.

## Purpose

Adds a separate candidate-excluded ensemble iteration mode that continues until the accepted candidate set converges, instead of stopping after a fixed number of candidate-excluded passes.

The previous fixed mode remains unchanged:

```powershell
--exclude-candidates-from-ensemble `
--candidate-ensemble-max-iterations 2
```

## New mode

```powershell
--exclude-candidates-from-ensemble `
--candidate-ensemble-until-converged
```

By default this uses a safety cap of 10 total ensemble iterations, counting the initial ensemble as iteration 1. The cap can be changed with:

```powershell
--candidate-ensemble-convergence-max-iterations 20
```

## New manifest fields

`quality_policy` now includes:

```text
candidate_ensemble_iteration_mode
candidate_ensemble_until_converged
candidate_ensemble_convergence_max_iterations
candidate_ensemble_iteration_limit
candidate_ensemble_converged
candidate_ensemble_stop_reason
candidate_ensemble_final_candidate_object_ids
candidate_ensemble_final_candidate_objects
candidate_ensemble_new_final_candidate_object_ids
candidate_ensemble_new_final_candidate_objects
candidate_ensemble_convergence_diagnostics
```

If the final candidate set is fully included in the cumulative exclusion set:

```text
candidate_ensemble_converged = true
candidate_ensemble_stop_reason = converged
```

If the safety cap is reached while new final candidates still appear:

```text
candidate_ensemble_converged = false
candidate_ensemble_stop_reason = max_iterations_reached_with_new_candidates
```

For fixed mode, the analogous non-converged state is:

```text
candidate_ensemble_stop_reason = fixed_iteration_limit_reached_with_new_candidates
```

## Compatibility

No database migration is required.

Existing fixed-iteration commands keep their previous behavior.

# Grandgousier MVP5.35.0 — spatial aperture correction

Base version: `0.5.34.4`.

This patch adds a per-frame small-to-large aperture correction before aperture-ZP calibration. The spatial model is activated only when its quality gate passes; otherwise downstream calibration uses the original raw measurements.

No database migration is added.

## Main diagnostics

- accepted frame fraction;
- constant/plane/identity frame counts;
- calibrator count per frame;
- correction median and detector-wide spatial amplitude;

- BIC improvement of the plane over the constant model;

```text
reports/check_05350_bklyn_20260328_i_aperture_correction.json
```

The manifest must contain a successful `apply_aperture_correction` step and identify the effective calibration used by aperture-ZP.

## Архивный источник: `README_MVP5_36_2_CANDIDATE_BOUNDARY_DIAGNOSTICS_PATCH.md`

# Grandgousier 0.5.36.2 — candidate boundary diagnostics

Версия 0.5.36.2 сохраняет пограничные переменные, которые не прошли ровно один low-amplitude criterion, но находятся не далее 10% от его порога.

## Научная семантика

Автоматический отбор не ослабляется. Пограничная строка получает `candidate_status=BORDERLINE`, пустой `candidate_origin` и `candidate_diagnostic_class=BORDERLINE_LOW_AMPLITUDE`. Она не исключается из ensemble reference list и не учитывается как автоматически принятый кандидат.

Для каждого low-amplitude критерия сохраняются:

- измеренное значение;
- порог;
- pass/fail;
- абсолютный margin `value - threshold`;
- относительный ratio `value / threshold`.

Borderline определяется только если:

- объект не принят ни одним автоматическим каналом;
- не пройден не более чем один активный low-amplitude criterion;
- минимальный threshold ratio не ниже 0.9.

## Экспорт

В каталоге `candidates` создаются:

- `borderline_candidates.csv`;
- `borderline_candidates.json`;
- `target_diagnostics.csv`;
- `target_diagnostics.json`;
- `candidate_membership_history.json`.

Для BORDERLINE и непринятых target-объектов сохраняются CSV/JSON light curves и PNG при доступном matplotlib. Они считаются diagnostic products и не увеличивают `accepted_candidate_count`.

## Membership provenance

Каждый field-QC проход сохраняет accepted, borderline и rejected object IDs. Между последовательными calibration branches вычисляются:

- accepted added/dropped;
- borderline added/dropped;
- accepted → borderline;
- borderline → accepted.

При цветовой калибровке дополнительно записываются selection/science statuses, origins и `membership_change` для каждого экспортируемого объекта.

## Совместимость

- Формулы фотометрии и ошибок не изменены.
- Candidate thresholds не изменены.
- Ensemble exclusion использует только `candidate_status=ACCEPTED`.
- Миграция БД не требуется.


## Известное ограничение экспорта

Реальный прогон подтвердил классификацию и diagnostic products, но compact candidate summary 0.5.36.2 публиковал не весь внутренний набор per-criterion полей. Полный перенос `value/threshold/pass/margin/ratio` исправлен в 0.5.36.3.

# Grandgousier 0.5.36.3 — candidate boundary provenance hotfix

0.5.36.2 correctly classified and exported borderline candidates, but the compact candidate summary schema exposed only selected margins and the global minimum ratio. The complete per-criterion diagnostics already existed in field-QC rows, yet were not copied through the science-calibration merge and were omitted from candidate summary CSV/JSON.

## Changes

For each low-amplitude criterion, candidate products now preserve:

- measured `value`;
- configured `threshold`;
- boolean `pass`;
- absolute `margin = value - threshold`;
- relative `ratio = value / threshold`.

The five criteria are:

- `n_measurements`;
- `intrinsic_rms`;
- `rms_over_mag_err`;
- `mad_over_mag_err`;
- `robust_peak_to_peak`.

A single canonical column list is used by field-QC CSV, science-branch merge, candidate summary, `borderline_candidates.csv/json`, `target_diagnostics.csv/json`, and per-object candidate JSON. This prevents future schema drift.

## Compatibility

- Photometric values are unchanged.
- Error propagation is unchanged.
- Candidate thresholds and statuses are unchanged.
- BORDERLINE objects remain diagnostic-only and are not excluded from the ensemble.
- No database migration is required.

## Архивный источник: `README_MVP5_37_0_PHYSICAL_RANDOM_ERROR_MODEL_PATCH.md`

# Grandgousier 0.5.37.0 — physical per-epoch random-error model

0.5.37.0 replaces the legacy aperture-photometry uncertainty formula with a physically decomposed per-epoch error budget while evaluating the legacy formula in parallel for A/B provenance.

## Physical variance model

All component variances are stored in ADU² before conversion to magnitude error:

```text
source Poisson                  = max(net_flux_ADU, 0) / gain
background in aperture         = n_ap * selected_pixel_variance
annulus-median estimate        = (pi/2) * n_ap^2 / n_sky * selected_pixel_variance
optional fractional floor      = (net_flux * fractional_flux_floor)^2
optional scintillation         = (net_flux * fractional_scintillation_sigma)^2
```

The detector prediction per pixel is:

```text
max(local_background_ADU, 0) / gain + (read_noise_e / gain)^2
```

By default, the selected per-pixel background variance is the maximum of the detector prediction and the robust empirical annulus variance. This avoids double-counting the same sky/read term while retaining measured flat-field and pixel-level excess noise.

The previous formula is retained exactly as:

```text
max(net_flux_ADU, 0) + n_ap * annulus_sigma_ADU^2
```

## Provenance

Each raw measurement stores both physical and legacy errors, every variance component, gain/read-noise source and fallback state, background-variance source, optional floor/scintillation state, and physical/legacy error ratio in the `random_error_*` namespace. That namespace is preserved through aperture, ZP, ensemble and color calibration.

Generated calibration names use a separate `errphys_v1` branch. The historical formula remains selectable as `legacy_aperture_v1` and uses `errlegacy_v1` names.

## Validation

The final internal ensemble references are used for a diagnostic normalized-residual comparison. The pipeline writes robust normalized sigma, RMS, reduced chi-square, magnitude-bin summaries and a non-applied scale recommendation for both models. No automatic rescaling or threshold change is performed in this release.

## Instrument policy

RoboPhot uses the profile gain/read-noise metadata and enables a Young-type scintillation term for a 0.60-m aperture at 290 m altitude. MASTER keeps scintillation disabled and records explicit gain/read-noise fallbacks until channel-specific metadata are supplied.

## Compatibility

- Candidate thresholds are unchanged.
- Candidate membership may change because `mag_err_random` changes by design.
- Aperture-correction differential uncertainty semantics are unchanged.
- Frame-common absolute transformation uncertainty remains in `mag_err_systematic`.
- No database migration is required beyond the existing 0.5.34.2 measurement error-component migration.

---

## Архивный источник: `README_MVP5_37_1_RESIDUAL_NOISE_FLOOR_DIAGNOSTICS_PATCH.md`

# Grandgousier 0.5.37.1 — residual noise-floor diagnostics

The real 0.5.37.0 RoboPhot run showed that `physical_aperture_v1` is close to normalized scatter unity at `16–17 mag`, while bright references retain an approximately additive residual scatter. A single multiplicative error scale would therefore overinflate faint-object errors.

## Lower-envelope estimator

For each final ensemble reference object, the validator estimates

```text
observed_robust_sigma = 1.4826 * MAD(mag - median(mag))
raw_residual_floor    = sqrt(max(observed_robust_sigma^2 - detector_error^2, 0))
```

Objects are grouped in magnitude bins. The configurable lower quantile of the per-object residual floor defines a quiet lower envelope, and the series-level suggested floor is the median of valid bin-envelope values. Objects on or below each bin envelope become diagnostic floor calibrators.

## Frame-common decomposition

For every frame, the median residual of lower-envelope calibrators estimates a common-mode term. The pipeline then repeats the lower-envelope calculation after subtracting this frame-common residual. Pairwise residual correlations are reported before and after the subtraction.

The decomposition is descriptive and does not assert that the remaining floor is caused by one specific detector or calibration process.

## Diagnostic uncertainty fields

The final internal ensemble branch and science branch receive flags:

```text
mag_err_detector
mag_err_epoch_floor
mag_err_effective
residual_noise_floor_applied = false
residual_noise_frame_common_sigma_mag
residual_noise_independent_floor_mag
```

`mag_err_random` is not modified.

## Candidate diagnostics

The accepted-candidate policy is unchanged. The existing `BORDERLINE` class still permits no more than one failed low-amplitude criterion. A second diagnostic channel now preserves objects that fail up to two criteria but remain within `borderline_threshold_ratio`:

```text
candidate_status           = DIAGNOSTIC
candidate_diagnostic_class = NEAR_THRESHOLD_LOW_AMPLITUDE
candidate_origin           = ""
```

These objects are exported but do not enter accepted counts and are never removed from the ensemble reference list because of this status.

New candidate products:

```text
candidates/near_threshold_candidates.csv
candidates/near_threshold_candidates.json
candidates/residual_floor_candidate_ab.csv
candidates/residual_floor_candidate_ab.json
```

The A/B files show how the low-amplitude ratios would change if the suggested floor were used. They do not alter classification.

## New random-error products

```text
random_error_model/residual_noise_floor_summary.json
random_error_model/residual_noise_floor_objects.csv
random_error_model/residual_noise_floor_frames.csv
```

## Compatibility

- no migration;
- physical detector/background error model unchanged;
- aperture, ensemble and color algorithms unchanged;
- no automatic floor or error rescale;
- no accepted-candidate threshold change.

## Архивный источник: `README_MVP5_37_2_RESIDUAL_FLOOR_SEMANTICS_HOTFIX_PATCH.md`

# Grandgousier 0.5.37.2 — residual-floor semantics hotfix

The real 0.5.37.1 RoboPhot run verified an additive lower-envelope floor near `0.02276 mag`, but also showed that subtracting the proposed frame-common residual made both diagnostics worse:

```text
floor:                  0.02276 -> 0.02504 mag
median |correlation|:   0.10612 -> 0.11391
```

Therefore the frame-common component is not supported by this series and the post-subtraction value must not be labelled an independent floor.

## Frame-common support gate

The decomposition is marked `SUPPORTED` only when both conditions pass:

```text
(floor_before - floor_after) / floor_before >= 0.05
median_abs_corr_before - median_abs_corr_after >= 0.01
```

Otherwise the measured after-common floor remains available as a descriptive diagnostic, while `residual_noise_floor_independent_mag` is null.

## Effective-error split

0.5.37.1 combined the floor only with the raw physical detector term. Derived measurements may also contain downstream random uncertainty, especially differential spatial aperture-correction covariance. 0.5.37.2 exports both quantities:

```text
mag_err_effective_detector_only = hypot(mag_err_detector, floor)
mag_err_effective_total         = hypot(mag_err_random, floor)
mag_err_effective               = mag_err_effective_total  # compatibility alias
```

Candidate A/B diagnostics use `mag_err_effective_total`.

## Compatibility

- `mag_err_random` is unchanged;
- the floor remains diagnostic and is not applied to ensemble weights;
- candidate thresholds and accepted membership semantics are unchanged;
- no database migration is added.

---

# Grandgousier 0.5.37.3 — catalog precondition and CLI inspection hotfix

1. `show-catalog-sources` no longer accesses unrelated parser fields

   its documented `catalog_name`, `offset`, `limit`, and output-format options.
2. SQL `OFFSET` and `LIMIT` are no longer applied a second time in Python.
3. `process-archive-path --catalog-name ...` now counts sources in the explicit
   identity catalog immediately after indexing. An empty or missing namespace

4. `--allow-empty-catalog` keeps the old empty-catalog path available only for
